domestic_evidence: No domestic-supply record found. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits are not public for this private limited company: Tofler page returned 404 (https://www.tofler.in/raja-fat-and-feeds-private-limited/company) and ZaubaCorp returned HTTP 403. DuckDuckGo search tool was unavailable during this run (connection refused), so no further domestic sources could be queried. Domestic turnover: null — not invented.
note: Two related but distinct registered entities appear in customs data: 'RAJA FAT AND FEEDS PVT LTD' (Lakkar Mandi Road; 118 shipment records, latest 2026-02-21) and 'RAJA FAT AND FEEDS PRIVATE LIMITED' (Industrial Area, Rajpura Town, Punjab; 19 records, latest 2025-11-06). Both show real, dated export bills of lading to Kuwait, Kenya, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, UAE, Netherlands and Russia. Declared HS codes 040811 / 040891 are directly confirmed by shipment records (04081100 egg yolk powder, 04089100 whole egg powder); 350211 (dried egg albumin) was not seen in the visible rows but is a plausible product of the same plant — no correction needed, HS is consistent with actual shipments. Export status confirmed by customs/B-L records, not by website claims. Domestic (India) supply side is unverified: no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence was retrievable, so it is recorded as unknown rather than assumed. No rejection grounds: the legal entity exists and is actively shipping.
